title: Quiz Show Games: Searching with Bimodal Hiding
summary: We consider a quiz show game in which a contestant is presented with a sequence of questions. Each time the contestant answers a question correctly, she receives a prize and proceeds to the next question; the probability of answering each question correctly is given. If the contestant answers a question incorrectly, she receives a consolation prize and the game ends. The contestant's problem of determining the optimal order in which to answer questions, for known fixed parameters, is a classic one studied in Kadane (1969), and admits a simple index-based solution.
